name: Cable Car Barn & Powerhouse
summary_en: The Cable Car Barn, Powerhouse and Museum at Washington and Mason Streets anchors these records. A 1980 East/West notice describes an $11,787,000 "Rehabilitation of Cable Car Barn," and a Civil Grand Jury report finds the barn, rebuilt in a 1982 project, was remade "without complete consideration for its intended functions." A Muni data guide notes the barn was built in 1887, rebuilt in 1982–84, spans 83,741 sq ft, and houses the cable car museum. A Hetch Hetchy report locates the cable-winding machinery in the Cable Car Powerhouse, and 2009 MTA minutes authorize a management agreement with the Friends of the Cable Car Museum. It is operated by the Municipal Transportation Agency, whose FY2025 budget line is about $1.5B.
